newsitem.title: UK: BSKYB elects permanent Pathe directors.
newsitem.headline: BSKYB elects permanent Pathe directors.

text.p: British Sky Broadcasting Plc shareholders on Friday voted to re-elect Pathe's Michel Crepon and Jerome Seydoux as directors and changed its articles so that they will not be subject to retirement by rotation.
The change was required after Chargeurs, which holds an almost 17 pct stake in BSkyB reorganised earlier this year and transferred the holding to its new Pathe unit.
This meant that the French group lost its legally enforceable right to board representation.

PIRC, the pensions and investment consultants, had criticised the move. Its research director Stuart Bell told the BSkyB meeting that the move was "retrograde and a poor example of corporate governance practice."
A small number of shareholders voted against the resolution at the meeting but BSkyB chairman Gerry Robinson said pledges had been received of which 96 percent were in favour of the change.
